About Renishaw

Transforming Tomorrow Together

Renishaw is a global provider of manufacturing technologies, analytical instruments and medical devices. We are guided by our purpose: Transforming Tomorrow Together.

Our purpose

We work with customers around the world to measure and manufacture with greater precision and efficiency. As the pace of technological change accelerates and resources become more scarce, our expertise enables high‑performance, intelligent solutions that make the best use of what matters most. Transforming Tomorrow Together remains central to everything we do, as we deliver more sustainable, productive ways of working and solutions that make a real difference.

Who we are

We are a global engineering technology group with core skills in measurement, motion control, spectroscopy and precision machining. We are also a world leader in additive manufacturing (metal 3D printing), designing compact machines that produce high‑performance parts from metal powder. Known for our precision, reliability and innovation, our technologies help transform product performance across industries including transport, agriculture, electronics and healthcare.

Our history: over 50 years of innovation

How we work

We work in close collaboration with our customers, building long‑term partnerships based on trust, shared expertise and a deep understanding of their challenges. By combining engineering and scientific insight, we help solve complex problems and turn ideas into practical, high‑performance solutions. Our approach to innovation is long‑term and responsible, focused on delivering reliable technologies that create lasting value for our customers and the world around us.

Our values

Our purpose, vision and strategy are supported by our values of innovation, inspiration, integrity and involvement. These values guide the way we behave and the decisions we make, both as a business and as individual employees.

Where we operate

We are a global business. We work closely with our customers around the world to solve complex engineering and science challenges and improve their products and processes.

We operate in three regions: APAC, EMEA and the Americas. Most of our research and development and manufacturing takes place in the UK, and we have other major manufacturing sites in Ireland and India.

Global locations

Looking to the future

As manufacturing continues to evolve, we are focused on enabling more sustainable, automated and data‑driven production environments. Our technologies are designed to help customers make better decisions, improve efficiency and adapt as processes become more connected and intelligent. By bringing together world-class engineering expertise and ongoing innovation, we stay relevant to today's challenges while helping shape the manufacturing systems of tomorrow.
